Topics covered in this PDF

BCOS-186 (Personal Selling and Salesmanship) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Customer behaviour, motivation and Maslow's theory, selling situations, sales force motivation and compensation plans, competencies of a successful salesperson
  • Motivational techniques, ethical and legal issues in selling, handling objections, sales reports, organisational and interpersonal skills, buyer versus consumer

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, course title Personal Selling and Salesmanship, coverage all blocks, maximum marks 100, attempt all questions. Section A: five questions (10 each). Section B: five questions (6 each). Section C: Q11 short notes and Q12 distinctions, each with two parts (5 x 2)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
